chunks: As for whatever is in it from Abū Kahmas, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Zarrād, from Abū Kahmas al-Kūfī.

key_terms.أَبِي كَهْمَسٍ الْكُوفِيِّ: Abū Kahmas al-Kūfī, the transmitter to whom this chain leads
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific prayer for the narrator’s father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, a narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Abū Kahmas in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage provides the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Abū Kahmas in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission through the author’s father and earlier narrators back to Abū Kahmas al-Kūfī.
